scene_metadata.title: The last train
scene_metadata.logline: On the roof, an hour before his train, a man who will not be asked to stay is finally undone by the person who will not ask.
scene_metadata.given_circumstances: Two years of Friday nights on this roof. Marlowe took a job in another city a month ago and told no one why. Iris has waited without asking. Dev came to see them off. The 23:40 train is the last one tonight.
scene_metadata.macro_conflict: Neither will say it first, and the train does not wait.

stage_frame.note: Spectate camera assumed south. Check before filming.

characters.name: Iris
characters.super_objective: To be chosen, not asked for.
characters.scene_goal: Get Marlowe to say he is staying without asking him.
characters.obstacle: Marlowe goes cold and practical when anyone gets close.
characters.expectation: If she stays dignified, he will see what he is leaving.

characters.name: Marlowe
characters.super_objective: To leave without having been the one who wanted to stay.
characters.scene_goal: Get through the hour without being asked, and without saying it first.
characters.obstacle: Iris's silence is harder to turn away from than a plea.
characters.expectation: If he stays cold, it will be over quickly and cleanly.

characters.name: Dev
characters.super_objective: To stop being the translator between them.
characters.scene_goal: Make them say it to each other.
characters.obstacle: Both of them deflect and expect him to cover the silence.
characters.expectation: If he speaks plainly once, they will take it from there.

dramatic_beats.subtext_prompt: I am already gone. Do not ask me.
I am not begging. Look at me and see what you are leaving.
She is standing right here. Stop pretending she is not.
I do not want to leave. I do not know how to say it.
